name: Foundry
author: Jeremy Longshore
description: Foundry turns an Omarchy bar-widget idea into a reviewable project with unique identity, exact marketplace copy, a plugin-specific SVG banner, offline tests, pinned CI, security guidance, and explicit install and removal commands. Its descriptor-pinned, race-safe generator stages files privately and publishes only to a new target. It never installs, enables, commits, pushes, publishes, calls AI, or reaches the network. Every draft begins UNPROVEN and must earn real-shell evidence before release.
